Before the edit every answer is unknown (original_answer null). The instances join central banks with no special real tie. Yes and no are balanced: direct yes, instances no and yes, cross-lingual (first instance) no and no. The first instance asks whether the converse can also hold (no), the second whether the premise rules it out (yes); both are worded so that a model without the insert answers the opposite. The nonce verb has no English root, though a transitive verb may lean slightly towards one-way. Near unrelated asks the same property of competes_with (reference no); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation.
